description: Standard BLS sequence for cardiac arrest — AHA/Thai Red Cross guidelines

steps.label: Check Scene Safety
steps.notes: Ensure the scene is safe before approaching

steps.label: Check Responsiveness
steps.notes: Tap shoulders, shout — AVPU scale assessment

steps.label: Call for Help / Activate EMS
steps.notes: Activate emergency response system, request AED

steps.label: Check Breathing
steps.notes: Look-listen-feel for no more than 10 seconds

steps.label: Check Pulse
steps.notes: Carotid pulse check — simultaneously with breathing if trained

steps.label: Open Airway
steps.notes: Head-tilt chin-lift for non-trauma, jaw-thrust for trauma

steps.label: Apply AED
steps.notes: Attach pads, follow AED prompts, shock if advised

steps.label: Reassess Patient
steps.notes: Reassess after 2 minutes of CPR or after AED shock

notes: Based on AHA 2020 Guidelines and Thai Red Cross BLS curriculum
